test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Prohibit
solution:
The correct answer is "**Ban"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There will be one correct option among the given four.
 
• **Ban** is the appropriate word that means prohibited. To ban something implies preventing it from occurring or becoming.
 
• Give an example for better **understanding**.
 
 
• ***Example: **Cell phones have been **banned** in school.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Aid is offering assistance or support. This is not a related word to prohibit.
 
 
• ***Example: **Ram gave money to **aid** the cause.*
 
 
 
• Allow is the verb form of permission. This is also not a synonym for Prohibit.
 
 
• ***Example: **The committee **allowed** them to enter the fair.*
 
 
 
• To assist means to provide extra support or assistance. The meaning of assist is not related to **prohibit**.
 
 
• ***Example :** The teacher is **assisted **by his speech.*
 
 
 
• The rest of the options are not related to **prohibit**.
